##### Result (Search)

The **Result** element is an optional child element of the **Store** element in **Search** command responses that serves a container for an individual matching mailbox items. The **Result** element is present only if there are matching items.

Elements referenced in this section are defined in the **Search** namespace, except where otherwise indicated by the presence of a namespace prefix (as defined in section [2.2.4](#Section_718fe481c75b4ff7bbf65cf3dd0f43d7)).

+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------+
| Command request/response                                                                    | Parent elements                                                              | Child elements                                                                             | Data type                                                                                                   | Number allowed    |

| **Search** command response (section [2.2.1.16](#Section_8211179b14f344ab9de6b69ca2a48c4e)) | **Store** (section [2.2.3.178.3](#Section_ce150549ce314b958b61ee7f3d75bd48)) | **airsync:Class** (section [2.2.3.27.5](#Section_c31d2c766498417d8bb7eea68b1210f0))        | **container** ([\[MS-ASDTYPE\]](%5bMS-ASDTYPE%5d.pdf#Section_dcfe20e1cb36457f8c7be5c61351f7d3) section 2.2) | 0\...N (optional) |
|                                                                                             |                                                                              |                                                                                            |                                                                                                             |                   |
|                                                                                             |                                                                              | **LongId** (section [2.2.3.98.3](#Section_a31a7c95c15c46808d43c734a3284dc9))               |                                                                                                             |                   |
|                                                                                             |                                                                              |                                                                                            |                                                                                                             |                   |
|                                                                                             |                                                                              | **airsync:CollectionId** (section [2.2.3.30.5](#Section_4d999297bfec4f138edcadebf2b60f5c)) |                                                                                                             |                   |
|                                                                                             |                                                                              |                                                                                            |                                                                                                             |                   |
|                                                                                             |                                                                              | **Properties** (section [2.2.3.139.3](#Section_29837fa342f04a119018bf9f0d9e2a94))          |                                                                                                             |                   |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------+

One **Result** element is present for each match that is found. If no matches are found, the **Result** element is not present in the **Store** container element of the response XML.

Inside the **Result** element, the **Properties** element contains a list of nonempty text properties on the entry.

When the store that is being searched is the mailbox:

-   There is one **Result** element for each match that is found in the mailbox. If no matches are found, an empty **Result** element is present in the **Store** container element of the response XML.

-   Inside the **Result** element, the **Properties** element contains a list of requested properties for the mailbox item.

When the store that is being searched is the document library:

-   The first result that is returned in the **Search** response is the metadata for the [**Root folder**](#gt_7caaf21a-bb6c-4d5b-9768-eccac5a8833f) or item to which the **documentlibrary:LinkId** element (section [2.2.3.50](#Section_f334dd2f88564cfa95d050365464e0cc)) value is pointing. The client can choose to ignore this entry if it does not require it.

-   If the **documentlibrary:LinkId** element value in the request points to a folder, the metadata properties of the folder are returned as the first item, and the contents of the folder are returned as subsequent results. The **Range** element (section [2.2.3.143.3](#Section_f6e7da2ce9174994816a9a368233c089)) applies to these results with no difference; for example, the index 0 would be for the root item to which the link is pointing.

-   If the **documentlibrary:LinkId** element value in the request points to an item, only one result is returned: the metadata for the item.

-   Inside the **Result** element, the **Properties** element contains a list of requested properties for the mailbox item.

  ----------------------------------- -----------------------------------

  12.0                                Yes

  12.1                                Yes

  14.0                                Yes

  14.1                                Yes

  16.0                                Yes

  16.1                                Yes

#### RightsManagementInformation

In **Settings** command requests, the **RightsManagementInformation** element is a container node that is used to request rights management information settings. #### SaveInSentItems

The **SaveInSentItems** element is an optional child element of the **SendMail** element in **SendMail** command requests, an optional child element of the **SmartForward** element in **SmartForward** command requests, and an optional child element of the **SmartReply** element in **SmartReply** command requests. In all contexts, the **SaveInSentItems** element specifies whether a copy of the message will be stored in the [**Sent Items folder**](#gt_fe856661-83ad-4264-85d4-f4c4fa4ce2cb). If the **SaveInSentItems** element is present, the message is stored; if not present, the message is not stored.

All elements referenced in this section are defined in the **ComposeMail** namespace.

  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Command request/response                                                                           Parent elements                                                                     Child elements   Data type   Number allowed
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ---------------- ----------- -------------------
  **SendMail** command request (section [2.2.1.17](#Section_172db9ec350f4bb194b10526f976ed5e))       **SendMail** (section [2.2.3.162](#Section_9b1754399ca345d08048de7056cd03fb))       None             None        0\...1 (optional)

  **SmartReply** command request (section [2.2.1.20](#Section_419e4fc2d0cb419ea94ddf4b8da0c98f))     **SmartReply** (section [2.2.3.170](#Section_778ff8edbe654c459f5dfe22c4fc3d90))     None             None        0\...1 (optional)
  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The **SaveInSentItems** element is an empty tag element, meaning it has no value or data type. It is distinguished only by the presence or absence of the \<SaveInSentItems/\> tag.

#### Server

The **Server** element is a required child element of the **Settings** element in **Autodiscover** command responses that encapsulates settings that apply to a particular server in the **Autodiscover** command response.

All elements referenced in this section are defined in the http://schemas.microsoft.com/exchange/autodiscover/mobilesync/responseschema/2006 namespace.

#### ServerData

The **ServerData** element is an optional child element of the **Server** element in **Autodiscover** command responses that specifies the template name for the client certificate.

All elements referenced in this section are defined in the http://schemas.microsoft.com/exchange/autodiscover/mobilesync/responseschema/2006 namespace.

  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Command request/response                                                                           Parent elements                                                               Child elements   Data type                                                                                                  Number allowed
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- ---------------- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------------
  **Autodiscover** command response (section [2.2.1.1](#Section_1a3e248319924581942e5f6214605062))   **Server** (section [2.2.3.164](#Section_e73323b5509f4069b25ae3709c20f42d))   None             **string** ([\[MS-ASDTYPE\]](%5bMS-ASDTYPE%5d.pdf#Section_dcfe20e1cb36457f8c7be5c61351f7d3) section 2.7)   0\...1 (optional)

  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The **ServerData** element is a **string** value that is present only when the **Type** element (section [2.2.3.186.1](#Section_25bfc54bb9b54f20bcf968999f52c2b0)) value is set to \"CertEnroll\".

  12.0                                Yes

  12.1                                Yes

  14.0                                Yes

  14.1                                Yes

  16.0                                Yes

  16.1                                Yes

#### ServerId

The **ServerId** element is used in the following command requests and responses:

-   **Find** command responses (section [2.2.1.2](#Section_2e6a37ac1b17421e85bc371cbddde930))

-   **FolderCreate** command responses (section [2.2.1.3](#Section_6f182dfb506e4e8ebe82ef814cc4e9d5))

-   **FolderDelete** command requests (section [2.2.1.4](#Section_731d53ee7f324888aee21072bc30c651))

-   **FolderSync** command responses (section [2.2.1.5](#Section_e4dc4ff8cf5a41d9abb86188068b0b9b))

-   **FolderUpdate** command requests (section [2.2.1.6](#Section_afcaf4ed11654f4eaeabf193cf0e9983))

-   **GetHierarchy** command response (section [2.2.1.8](#Section_2852ec1492224eb7b52495abfb621598))

-   **ItemOperations** command requests and responses (section [2.2.1.10](#Section_9d4264fb42f547fb81335e68c52dd339))

-   **Sync** command requests and responses (section [2.2.1.21](#Section_89449dc4678c4deb9be2e1dbbc43e2f5))

The definition of the **ServerId** element differs according to the context in which it is used. For more details, see section [2.2.3.166.1](#Section_61ad482d026b4791a1c2d03ebf3706cc), section [2.2.3.166.2](#Section_9f40d89d6dc547e18363f300f0060bb9), section [2.2.3.166.3](#Section_38f60c5eb0f64c0d93d5a943194457e2), section [2.2.3.166.4](#Section_80e7ad4e64ea4e59a90dd98c2e0f3ad1), section [2.2.3.166.5](#Section_4ad53116b6884062aad9c547ba77e300), section [2.2.3.166.6](#Section_4463d961be6d46ceb4cc1ae1e58ac72c), section [2.2.3.166.7](#Section_2b9f2650130b4864b51ac58f83a51f38) and section [2.2.3.166.8](#Section_a875f1e437ae4ec3832f2e1867c13c0a).

##### ServerId (FolderCreate)

The **ServerId** element is an optional child element of the **FolderCreate** element in **FolderCreate** command responses that uniquely identifies a new folder on a server. The **ServerId** of the new folder is returned to the client after a successful **FolderCreate** command request (section [2.2.1.3](#Section_6f182dfb506e4e8ebe82ef814cc4e9d5)). The **ServerId** can also be used in the **ServerId** element of future **FolderDelete** command requests (section [2.2.1.4](#Section_731d53ee7f324888aee21072bc30c651)) and **FolderUpdate** command requests (section [2.2.1.6](#Section_afcaf4ed11654f4eaeabf193cf0e9983)). The client MUST store the **ServerId** for each folder and MUST be able to locate a folder on the client given a **ServerId**.

All elements referenced in this section are defined in the **FolderHierarchy** namespace.

  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Command request/response            Parent elements                                                                    Child elements   Data type                                                                                                  Number allowed
  ----------------------------------- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ---------------- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------------
  **FolderCreate** command response   **FolderCreate** (section [2.2.3.72](#Section_a6a5a0b4b7cb41c4981fa066335c070d))   None             **string** ([\[MS-ASDTYPE\]](%5bMS-ASDTYPE%5d.pdf#Section_dcfe20e1cb36457f8c7be5c61351f7d3) section 2.7)   0\...1 (optional)

  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The **ServerId** element MUST be returned if the **FolderCreate** command request was successful and the element MUST NOT be returned if the **FolderCreate** command request fails. The **ServerId** element value can be up to 64 characters in length.

**Protocol Versions**

The following table specifies the protocol versions that support this element. The client indicates the protocol version being used by setting either the MS-ASProtocolVersion header, as specified in [\[MS-ASHTTP\]](%5bMS-ASHTTP%5d.pdf#Section_4cbf28dc287641c69d87ba9db86cd40d) section 2.2.1.1.2.6, or the **Protocol version** field, as specified in \[MS-ASHTTP\] section 2.2.1.1.1.1, in the request.

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  Protocol version                    Element support
  ----------------------------------- -----------------------------------
  2.5                                 Yes

  12.0                                Yes

  12.1                                Yes

  14.0                                Yes

  14.1                                Yes

  16.0                                Yes

  16.1                                Yes
  -----------------------------------------------------------------------

##### ServerId (FolderDelete)

The **ServerId** element is a required child element of the **FolderDelete** element in **FolderDelete** command requests that specifies the folder on the server to be deleted, and it is a unique identifier assigned by the server to each folder that can be synchronized.

All elements referenced in this section are defined in the **FolderHierarchy** namespace.

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Command request/response                                                                          Parent elements                                                                    Child elements   Data type                                                                                                  Number allowed
  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ---------------- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ------------------
  **FolderDelete** command request (section [2.2.1.4](#Section_731d53ee7f324888aee21072bc30c651))   **FolderDelete** (section [2.2.3.73](#Section_734a6d368d804de5a67512eaea428b94))   None             **string** ([\[MS-ASDTYPE\]](%5bMS-ASDTYPE%5d.pdf#Section_dcfe20e1cb36457f8c7be5c61351f7d3) section 2.7)   1...1 (required)

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The server ID of the folder to be deleted is returned to the client in the **ServerId** element of a previous **FolderSync** command (section [2.2.1.5](#Section_e4dc4ff8cf5a41d9abb86188068b0b9b)) or **FolderCreate** command (section [2.2.1.3](#Section_6f182dfb506e4e8ebe82ef814cc4e9d5)). The client MUST store the server ID for each folder and MUST be able to locate a folder given a server ID.

The client MUST store the synchronization key as an opaque string of up to 64 characters.

**Protocol Versions**

The following table specifies the protocol versions that support this element. The client indicates the protocol version being used by setting either the MS-ASProtocolVersion header, as specified in [\[MS-ASHTTP\]](%5bMS-ASHTTP%5d.pdf#Section_4cbf28dc287641c69d87ba9db86cd40d) section 2.2.1.1.2.6, or the **Protocol version** field, as specified in \[MS-ASHTTP\] section 2.2.1.1.1.1, in the request.

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------

  ----------------------------------- -----------------------------------
  2.5                                 Yes

  12.0                                Yes

  12.1                                Yes

  14.0                                Yes

  14.1                                Yes

  16.0                                Yes

  16.1                                Yes
  -----------------------------------------------------------------------

##### ServerId (FolderSync)

The **ServerId** element is a required child element of the **Update** element, the **Delete** element, and the **Add** element in **FolderSync** command responses. In all contexts, it specifies the server-unique identifier for a folder on the server.

All elements referenced in this section are defined in the **FolderHierarchy** namespace.

  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Command request/response                                                                         Parent elements                                                                Child elements   Data type                                                                                                  Number allowed
  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ---------------- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ------------------
  **FolderSync** command response (section [2.2.1.5](#Section_e4dc4ff8cf5a41d9abb86188068b0b9b))   **Update** (section [2.2.3.187](#Section_f1f1297d9eff43f7aabd802dc4c94a80))    None             **string** ([\[MS-ASDTYPE\]](%5bMS-ASDTYPE%5d.pdf#Section_dcfe20e1cb36457f8c7be5c61351f7d3) section 2.7)   1...1 (required)

  **FolderSync** command response                                                                  **Delete** (section [2.2.3.42.1](#Section_34435a5439f04bcc89e350c019317f05))   None             **string**                                                                                                 1...1 (required)

  **FolderSync** command response                                                                  **Add** (section [2.2.3.7.1](#Section_615f4364b86a40caa8a0cae720778a50))       None             **string**                                                                                                 1...1 (required)
  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The **ServerId** element is used to identify folders that have been updated, deleted, or added on the server.

The client MUST store the server ID as an opaque string of up to 64 characters.

Each **Update** element, each **Delete** element, and each **Add** element included in a **FolderSync** response MUST contain one **ServerId** element.

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  Protocol version                    Element support
  ----------------------------------- -----------------------------------
  2.5                                 Yes

  12.0                                Yes

  12.1                                Yes

  14.0                                Yes

  14.1                                Yes

  16.0                                Yes

  16.1                                Yes
  -----------------------------------------------------------------------

##### ServerId (FolderUpdate)

The **ServerId** element is a required child element of the **FolderUpdate** element in **FolderUpdate** command requests that identifies the folder on the server to be renamed or moved.

All elements referenced in this section are defined in the **FolderHierarchy** namespace.

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Command request/response                                                                          Parent elements                                                                    Child elements   Data type                                                                                                  Number allowed
  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ---------------- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ------------------
  **FolderUpdate** command request (section [2.2.1.6](#Section_afcaf4ed11654f4eaeabf193cf0e9983))   **FolderUpdate** (section [2.2.3.77](#Section_468b81f001bf4251a7ebf6710c28c577))   None             **string** ([\[MS-ASDTYPE\]](%5bMS-ASDTYPE%5d.pdf#Section_dcfe20e1cb36457f8c7be5c61351f7d3) section 2.7)   1...1 (required)

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The server ID is obtained from the **ServerId** element of a previous **FolderSync** command (section [2.2.1.5](#Section_e4dc4ff8cf5a41d9abb86188068b0b9b)) or **FolderCreate** command (section [2.2.1.3](#Section_6f182dfb506e4e8ebe82ef814cc4e9d5)). The **ServerId** specifies a unique identifier assigned by the server to each object that can be synchronized. The client MUST store the **ServerId** for each folder and MUST be able to locate a folder given a **ServerId**.

The client MUST store the **ServerId** as an opaque string of up to 64 characters.

##### ServerId (ItemOperations)

The **airsync:ServerId** element is an optional child element of the **Fetch** element in **ItemOperations** command requests and responses. It specifies a unique identifier that is assigned by the server to each object that can be synchronized or have an item operation applied to it. This element is defined in the **AirSync** namespace.

Elements referenced in this section are defined in the **ItemOperations** namespace, except where otherwise indicated by the presence of a namespace prefix (as defined in section [2.2.4](#Section_718fe481c75b4ff7bbf65cf3dd0f43d7)).

  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Command request/response                                                                                             Parent elements                                                               Child elements   Data type                                                                                                  Number allowed
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- ---------------- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------------
  **ItemOperations** command request (section [2.2.1.10](#Section_9d4264fb42f547fb81335e68c52dd339)) fetch operation   **Fetch** (section [2.2.3.67.1](#Section_7782504c43f24cef91472d61ce8aa4e3))   None             **string** ([\[MS-ASDTYPE\]](%5bMS-ASDTYPE%5d.pdf#Section_dcfe20e1cb36457f8c7be5c61351f7d3) section 2.7)   0\...1 (optional)

  **ItemOperations** command response fetch operation                                                                  **Fetch**                                                                     None             **string**                                                                                                 0\...1 (optional)
  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The client MUST store the value of the **airsync:ServerId** element for any item that is retrieved by means of the **Sync** command (section [2.2.1.21](#Section_89449dc4678c4deb9be2e1dbbc43e2f5)) or **Search** command (section [2.2.1.16](#Section_8211179b14f344ab9de6b69ca2a48c4e)). In an **ItemOperations** request, the **airsync:ServerId** element can be used by the **Fetch** element to refer to the location of the item in question.

##### ServerId (Sync)

The **ServerId** element is a required child element of the **Change** element, the **Delete** element, and the **Fetch** element in **Sync** command requests. It is an optional child element of the **Add** element, the **Change** element, the **Delete** element, and the **Fetch** element under the **Responses** element (section [2.2.3.154](#Section_f98e79f2204f4014a7d766c37db8e04f)) in **Sync** command responses. It is a required child element of the **Add** element, the **Change** element, the **Delete** element, the **Fetch** element, and the **SoftDelete** element under the **Commands** element (section [2.2.3.32](#Section_5a54d46c823d44ff8a8691ba4d4af77f)) in **Sync** command responses. It represents a unique identifier that is assigned by the server to each object that can be synchronized. When using protocol version 16.1, a given item MUST have the same **ServerId** value after a resynchronization or when retrieved by a different client. The client MUST store the server ID for each object as an opaque string of up to 64 characters and MUST be able to locate an object given a server ID.

All elements referenced in this section are defined in the **AirSync** namespace.

#### Set

Using the **Settings** command **Oof** request, the client can set the following:

-   OOF state

-   Start time and end time, if the user wants to schedule an OOF message

-   OOF message or messages for one or more of the supported audiences

Using the **Settings** command **DevicePassword** request, the client can set or clear the recovery password of the device.

Using the **Settings** command **DeviceInformation** request, clients SHOULD\<14\> send **DeviceInformation** parameters to the server before the **FolderSync** command (section [2.2.1.5](#Section_e4dc4ff8cf5a41d9abb86188068b0b9b)). If the server allows non-provisionable devices, non-provisionable client SHOULD send **DeviceInformation** parameters to the server; otherwise, client SHOULD send **DeviceInformation** parameters to the server as soon as possible after the client has been provisioned. **Set** enables the client to specify values for any of the **DeviceInformation** parameters. The following statements apply to the **Set** element request implementation:

-   The client SHOULD specify all supported **DeviceInformation** parameters in the **Set** request. An error is not returned if all **DeviceInformation** parameters are not set if at least one **DeviceInformation** parameter is set.

-   The client or server makes no assumptions about ordering. The **DeviceInformation** parameters can be specified in any order.

-   To delete a given **DeviceInformation** value, the client MUST send the **Set** element as an empty element.

#### SoftDelete

The **SoftDelete** element is an optional child element of the **Commands** element in **Sync** command responses that deletes an object from the client when it falls outside the **FilterType** (section [2.2.3.68.2](#Section_de626aeace5340c2abcf19eb8213ea6c)) results or it is no longer included as part of the **SyncOptions** (section [2.2.3.125.6](#Section_38f4e9fb6080456aac8f07b806aae86e)) instructions. The object that is soft deleted is identified by its **ServerId** element.

All elements referenced in this section are defined in the **AirSync** namespace.

  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Command request/response                                                                    Parent elements                                                                Child elements                                                                    Data type                                                                                                     Number allowed
  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------------
  **Sync** command response (section [2.2.1.21](#Section_89449dc4678c4deb9be2e1dbbc43e2f5))   **Commands** (section [2.2.3.32](#Section_5a54d46c823d44ff8a8691ba4d4af77f))   **ServerId** (section [2.2.3.166.8](#Section_a875f1e437ae4ec3832f2e1867c13c0a))   **container** ([\[MS-ASDTYPE\]](%5bMS-ASDTYPE%5d.pdf#Section_dcfe20e1cb36457f8c7be5c61351f7d3) section 2.2)   0\...N (optional)

  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The **SoftDelete** element contains any items that are filtered out of the **Sync** query due to being outside the **FilterType** date range, or no longer specified as part of the **SyncOptions** instructions. For example, if the **SyncOptions** element no longer specifies SMS class items as being synchronized, the current SMS items on the device will be soft deleted.

#### SrcFldId

The **SrcFldId** element is a required child element of the **Move** element in **MoveItems** command requests that specifies the server ID of the source folder (that is, the folder that contains the items to be moved).

Elements referenced in this section are defined in the **Move** namespace, except where otherwise indicated by the presence of a namespace prefix (as defined in section [2.2.4](#Section_718fe481c75b4ff7bbf65cf3dd0f43d7)).

  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The server ID of the source folder is obtained from the **folderhierarchy:ServerId** element (section [2.2.3.166](#Section_52b4b13cc4e2492496af082280c14de9)) of a previous **FolderSync** command (section [2.2.1.5](#Section_e4dc4ff8cf5a41d9abb86188068b0b9b)) or **FolderCreate** command (section [2.2.1.3](#Section_6f182dfb506e4e8ebe82ef814cc4e9d5)). The **SrcFldId** element value can be up to 64 characters in length.

#### StartTime

The **StartTime** element is used in the following command requests and responses:

The definition of the **StartTime** element differs according to the context in which it is used. For more details, see section [2.2.3.176.1](#Section_fd94d8a06bac445498f412b0e382cf33) and section [2.2.3.176.2](#Section_b2d8271067674c4980a5b43f60bc1b3a).

##### StartTime (ResolveRecipients)

The **StartTime** element is a required child element of the **Availability** element in **ResolveRecipients** command requests that identifies the start of the span of free/busy time requested by the client.

All elements referenced in this section are defined in the **ResolveRecipients** namespace.

  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Command request/response                                                                                Parent elements                                                                    Child elements   Data type                                                                                                    Number allowed
  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ---------------- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ -------------------

  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

If the **Availability** element is included in the request, the request MUST also include the **StartTime** element.

If the client sends an invalid **StartTime** element value, then the server returns a **Status** element (section [2.2.3.177.12](#Section_71628fd7d2a54bb2a6afabedbaa341d9)) value of 5 in the **ResolveRecipients** command response.

##### StartTime (Settings)

The **StartTime** element is an optional child element of the **Set** element in **Settings** command **Oof** requests and an optional child element of the **Get** element in **Settings** command **Oof** responses. It is used with the **EndTime** element (section [2.2.3.61.2](#Section_6ee7533d303d4967b0d882a3b51ce242)) to specify the range of time during which the user is out of office.

All elements referenced in this section are defined in the **Settings** namespace.

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Command request/response                                                                               Parent elements                                                            Child elements   Data type                                                                                                    Number allowed
  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ -------------------------------------------------------------------------- ---------------- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ -------------------
  **Settings** command **Oof** request (section [2.2.1.18](#Section_b5a1ed99a7ac4d0baacb40ac792d0a91))   **Set** (section [2.2.3.167](#Section_bde5614905d34a619d790a73c80fe393))   None             **datetime** ([\[MS-ASDTYPE\]](%5bMS-ASDTYPE%5d.pdf#Section_dcfe20e1cb36457f8c7be5c61351f7d3) section 2.3)   0\...1 (optional)

  **Settings** command **Oof** response                                                                  **Get** (section [2.2.3.83](#Section_c005d3d1217c45c3afe5d7562cd8345a))    None             **datetime**                                                                                                 0\...1 (optional)
  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The **StartTime** element can be present within the **Get** element of the **Settings** response for the **Oof** element (section [2.2.3.122](#Section_30eaf13318c54c218b977984b52aa9d4)), or within the **Set** element of the **Settings** request for the **Oof** element.

In a **Set** **Oof** node, both **StartTime** and **EndTime** elements MUST be included in the **Settings** request, or neither the **StartTime** element nor the **EndTime** element MUST be included in the **Settings** request. If either the **StartTime** element or the **EndTime** element is included in the request without the other, a **Status** element (section [2.2.3.177.15](#Section_edc5c50b7a4e44ed865c28f814af41c6)) value of 2 is returned as a child element of the **Oof** element.

  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Command request/response                                                                           Parent elements                                                             Child elements   Data type                                                                                                   Number allowed
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- ---------------- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------------

  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ------- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

##### Status (Find)

The **Status** element is a required child element of the **Find** element and the **Response** element in **Find** command responses.

Elements referenced in this section are defined in the **Find** namespace.

+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------+
| Command request/response                                                                 | Parent elements                                                                 | Child elements | Data type                                                                                                 | Number allowed   |

| **Find** command response (section [2.2.1.2](#Section_2e6a37ac1b17421e85bc371cbddde930)) | **Find** (section [2.2.3.69](#Section_7a0b9ed81b924f878f6ad759249a91e4))        | None           | **integer** ([\[MS-ASDTYPE\]](%5bMS-ASDTYPE%5d.pdf#Section_dcfe20e1cb36457f8c7be5c61351f7d3) section 2.6) | 1...1 (required) |
|                                                                                          |                                                                                 |                |                                                                                                           |                  |
|                                                                                          | **Response** (section [2.2.3.153.2](#Section_bf3f210d9e4746aeabc826c66de43711)) |                |                                                                                                           |                  |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------+

As a child element of the **Find** element, the **Status** element indicates whether the server encountered an error while it was processing the **Find** query. The **Status** element value indicates only that the overall **Find** command request (section 2.2.1.2) was processed correctly. It does not indicate whether any matches were found. The **Total** (section [2.2.3.184.1](#Section_35a2977c67194a3bb5e71314b8d50a4a)) and **Range** (section [2.2.3.143.1](#Section_28b5306dd2024de58d112705f00c933f)) elements in the **Find** command response indicate how many matches were found and returned, respectively.

As a child element of the **Response** element, the **Status** element indicates whether the server encountered an error while it was processing the **Find** query. The following table lists the status codes for the **Find** command. For information about the scope of the status value and for status values common to all ActiveSync commands, see section [2.2.2](#Section_95cb9d7cd33d4b949366d59911c7a060).

+-------+--------------------------+--------------------------------------------+----------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Value | Meaning                  | Cause                                      | Parent Elements      | Resolution                                                                                                                             |
+=======+==========================+============================================+======================+========================================================================================================================================+
| 1     | Success.                 | Server successfully completed command.     | **Find** element     | None.                                                                                                                                  |
|       |                          |                                            |                      |                                                                                                                                        |
|       |                          |                                            | **Response** element |                                                                                                                                        |
+-------+--------------------------+--------------------------------------------+----------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 2     | The request was invalid. | The client\'s search failed to validate.   | **Find** element     | Double-check the request for accuracy.                                                                                                 |
|       |                          |                                            |                      |                                                                                                                                        |
|       |                          |                                            | **Response** element |                                                                                                                                        |
+-------+--------------------------+--------------------------------------------+----------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 3     | FolderSync required.     | The folder hierarchy is out of date.       | **Find** element     | Issue a **FolderSync** command (section [2.2.1.5](#Section_e4dc4ff8cf5a41d9abb86188068b0b9b)) and then try the **Find** command again. |
+-------+--------------------------+--------------------------------------------+----------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 4     | StartWithRangeZero       | The requested range does not begin with 0. | **Response** element | Issue a new **Find** request with a **Range** value that begins with 0.                                                                |
+-------+--------------------------+--------------------------------------------+----------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

The **Status** element is a required child element of the **FolderCreate** element in **FolderCreate** command responses that indicates the success or failure of a **FolderCreate** command request (section [2.2.1.3](#Section_6f182dfb506e4e8ebe82ef814cc4e9d5)). If the command failed, the **Status** element contains a code indicating the type of failure.

All elements referenced in this section are defined in the **FolderHierarchy** namespace.

  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Command request/response            Parent elements                                                                    Child elements   Data type                                                                                                   Number allowed
  ----------------------------------- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ---------------- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ------------------
  **FolderCreate** command response   **FolderCreate** (section [2.2.3.72](#Section_a6a5a0b4b7cb41c4981fa066335c070d))   None             **integer** ([\[MS-ASDTYPE\]](%5bMS-ASDTYPE%5d.pdf#Section_dcfe20e1cb36457f8c7be5c61351f7d3) section 2.6)   1...1 (required)

  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The following table lists the status codes for the **FolderCreate** command (section 2.2.1.3). For information about the scope of the status value and for status values common to all ActiveSync commands, see section [2.2.2](#Section_95cb9d7cd33d4b949366d59911c7a060).

  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Value   Meaning                                                        Cause                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   Scope     Resolution
  ------- -------------------------------------------------------------- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- --------- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  1       Success.                                                       Server successfully completed command.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Global    None.

  2       A folder that has this name already exists.                    The parent folder already contains a folder that has this name.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         Item      Prompt user to supply a unique name.

  3       The specified parent folder is a special system folder.        The specified parent folder is the Recipient information folder.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Item      Create the folder under a different parent.

  5       The specified parent folder was not found.                     The parent folder does not exist on the server, possibly because it has been deleted or renamed.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Item      Issue a **FolderSync** command (section [2.2.1.5](#Section_e4dc4ff8cf5a41d9abb86188068b0b9b)) for the new hierarchy and prompt the user for a new parent folder.

  6       An error occurred on the server.                               Server misconfiguration, temporary system issue, or bad item. This is frequently a transient condition.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 Global    Retry the **FolderSync** command. If continued attempts to synchronization fail, consider returning to synchronization key zero (0).

  9       Synchronization key mismatch or invalid synchronization key. Global    Double-check the request for accuracy.

Unknown.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Global.   None.

  12      Code unknown.                                                  Unusual back-end issue.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 Global    None.

##### Status (FolderSync)

The **Status** element is a required child element of the **FolderSync** element in **FolderSync** command responses that indicates the success or failure of a **FolderSync** command request (section [2.2.1.5](#Section_e4dc4ff8cf5a41d9abb86188068b0b9b)).

Global   Retry the **FolderSync** command. If continued attempts to synchronization fail, consider returning to synchronization key zero (0).

  9       Synchronization key mismatch or invalid synchronization key.   The client sent a malformed or mismatched synchronization key, or the synchronization state is corrupted on the server.   Global   Delete items added since last synchronization and return to synchronization key zero (0).

  10      Incorrectly formatted request.                                 The client sent a **FolderSync** command request that contains a semantic or syntactic error.                             Global   Double-check the request for accuracy.

Global   Retry the **FolderSync** command. If continued attempts to synchronization fail, consider returning to synchronization key zero (0).

The **Status** element is a required child element of the **Response** element and an optional child element of the **MoveItems** element in **MoveItems** command responses that indicates the success or failure the **MoveItems** command request (section [2.2.1.12](#Section_92958692b116462f871ceaab66076da1)). If the command failed, **Status** contains a code indicating the type of failure.

All elements referenced in this section are defined in the **Move** namespace.

  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Command request/response         Parent elements                                                                   Child elements   Data type                                                                                                   Number allowed
  -------------------------------- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ---------------- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ------------------
  **MoveItems** command response   **Response** (section [2.2.3.153.5](#Section_cf8a82a541b64d88bc41e4b4ec2d3122))   None             **integer** ([\[MS-ASDTYPE\]](%5bMS-ASDTYPE%5d.pdf#Section_dcfe20e1cb36457f8c7be5c61351f7d3) section 2.6)   1...1 (required)

  **MoveItems** command response   **MoveItems** (section [2.2.3.119](#Section_287534621b744748b78d0a56adbdb932))    None             **integer**                                                                                                 0...1 (optional)
  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The following table lists the status codes for the **MoveItems** command (section 2.2.1.12). For information about the scope of the status value and for status values common to all ActiveSync commands, see section [2.2.2](#Section_95cb9d7cd33d4b949366d59911c7a060).

  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Value   Meaning                                                                                                                                           Cause                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Scope    Resolution
  ------- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  1       Invalid source collection ID or invalid source Item ID.                                                                                           The source folder collection ID (**CollectionId** element (section [2.2.3.30.6](#Section_9a357d6014ba454e979cb3d933850e52)) value) is not recognized by the server, possibly because the source folder has been deleted. Or, the item with the Item ID (**SrcMsgId** element (section [2.2.3.175](#Section_bbd05a4b0b244fd2808a50f7b6dc6d64))) has been previously moved out of the folder with the Folder ID (**SrcFldId** element (section [2.2.3.174](#Section_de78638722d44f6baaae311dd5d8da05))).   Item     Issue a **FolderSync** command (section [2.2.1.5](#Section_e4dc4ff8cf5a41d9abb86188068b0b9b)) to get the new hierarchy. Then, issue a **Sync** command (section [2.2.1.21](#Section_89449dc4678c4deb9be2e1dbbc43e2f5)) for the **SrcFldId** and reissue the **MoveItems** command request if the items are still present in this source collection.

  2       Invalid destination collection ID.                                                                                                                The destination folder collection ID (**CollectionId** element value) is not recognized by the server, possibly because the source folder has been deleted.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Item     Issue a **FolderSync** command to get the new hierarchy. Then, use a valid collection ID.

  3       Success.                                                                                                                                          Server successfully completed command.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   Global   None.

  4       Source and destination collection IDs are the same.                                                                                               The client supplied a destination folder that is the same as the source.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 Item     Send only requests where the **CollectionId** element values for the source and destination differ.

  5       One of the following failures occurred: the item cannot be moved to more than one item at a time, or the source or destination item was locked.   More than one **DstFldId** element (section [2.2.3.51.2](#Section_539f1ab91bd94c3d9a7e85e7d7b241af)) was included in the request.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Global   Retry the **MoveItems** command request with only one **DstFldId** element or move the item to another location.

  7       Source or destination item was locked.                                                                                                            Transient server condition.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Item     Retry the **MoveItems** command request.
  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
